morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，现代马来语中不拆为本族词缀；é 表示 /e/，不是央元音 /ə/。

senses.zh_definition: 专业职业；尤其指需要较高学历和专门训练才能从事的职业，如医学、法律及会计。
senses.en_definition: An occupation requiring advanced education and specialized training, especially in a field such as medicine, law, or accountancy.
senses.ms_definition: Pekerjaan terutamanya yang memerlukan pelajaran yang tinggi dan latihan khas, misalnya dalam bidang undang-undang, perubatan dan perakaunan.
senses.nuances: 侧重职业所需的专门知识与训练。pekerjaan 泛指工作，kerjaya 侧重长期职业发展，profesional 可指专业人士或专业的表现。释义依据：[DBP PRPM：profesion](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=profesion)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Program latihan berterusan ini bertujuan meningkatkan mutu profesion perguruan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这项持续培训计划旨在提升教师队伍的专业水平。
dual_scenarios.en: This continuing training programme aims to raise standards in the teaching profession.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kau memang nak masuk profesion perguruan ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah kamu benar-benar mahu menceburi profesion perguruan?
dual_scenarios.en: Do you really want to go into teaching?
spoken_features: kau 是熟人之间使用的非正式第二人称。
句末 ke 表示口语疑问。
masuk 在口语中可对应较正式的 menceburi。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau memang nak masuk profesion perguruan ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu benar-benar mahu menceburi profesion perguruan?
messages.en: Do you really want to go into teaching?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, aku dah mohon program pendidikan. Aku suka ajar budak-budak.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya sudah memohon untuk mengikuti program pendidikan. Saya suka mengajar kanak-kanak.
messages.zh: 对啊，我已经申请教育课程了。我挺喜欢教小朋友的。
messages.en: Yeah, I’ve already applied for a teacher education programme. I enjoy teaching kids.

etymology.historical_story: Malay profesion belongs to the international vocabulary represented by English profession. The English word traces through French to Latin professio, a public declaration. Its earlier religious associations involved declared commitments; its occupational meaning later developed around a recognized calling and specialist knowledge. Malay usage emphasizes education and training rather than the older religious senses. [Etymology reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/profession).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 profesion 和熟悉的 profession 连起来记：需要专业训练的职业；é 读清楚的 /e/。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 适合教育、职业介绍和专业伦理讨论。询问陌生人的工作时，Apakah pekerjaan anda? 通常比直接问 profesion 更自然。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 不宜用是否属于 profesion 来评判工作的社会价值；介绍具体职业时，直接说 guru、doktor 或 akauntan 往往更清楚。
